content_units: Madrid to Valencia Daylight Drive Vibe
A sunlit highway playlist should start breezy, build into confident sing-along momentum, hit a big open-road peak mid-drive, then ease into a softer coastal landing.
This 25-song sequence follows your mix closely:   10 upbeat indie pop, 8 classic sing-along rock, 5 warm electronic, 2 mellow reset tracks  .

Energy Arc for the Drive
-   Tracks 1-5:   bright departure energy leaving Madrid; melodic, light, and road-ready.
-   Tracks 6-12:   the rhythm tightens and the drive opens up with glossy electronic warmth and first sing-along lifts.
-   Tracks 13-17:   peak stretch; biggest choruses, strongest windows-down momentum.
-   Tracks 18-19:   brief emotional reset without losing motion.
-   Tracks 20-23:   final scenic surge before Valencia with anthemic and synth-forward energy.
-   Tracks 24-25:   soft golden-hour landing into the city.
